cases.request: An initial amount of 2400000 grows by 18% per year for 3 years. Compute the final value in USD and verify the material result.
Monthly logo retention is 96.5%. Compute 12-month retention, compounded annual churn, linear annual churn approximation, and the percentage-point difference. Verify every material result.
Discount cash flows of 140000 at year 1, 175000 at year 2, and 210000 at year 3 using an 11% annual discount rate. Compute each PV and the total PV in USD. Verify every material result.
A product sells for 85 USD, variable cost is 34 USD per unit, and fixed cost is 255000 USD. Compute contribution per unit and break-even units. Verify both.
Three customer cohorts have 120 users at 8% conversion, 250 users at 13% conversion, and 80 users at 21% conversion. Compute the weighted overall conversion rate.
Compute the present value of a 500000 USD payment received 4 years from now. No discount rate is provided.
For observed values [12, 15, 15, 18, 20, 25], compute and verify the mean and median using a deterministic statistical analysis.
Revenue is stated as both 1.2 million USD and 1.5 million USD for the same company, same period, same accounting basis. Compute net margin using operating profit of 180000 USD.
